qualitative.gate_2_reason: Substantial revenue base concentrated in non-Western, emerging, and pariah jurisdictions (including ongoing Russian operations and high exposure to Nigeria and Egypt) lacking rule of law and stable property rights.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Generates nearly half of volume and substantial earnings from non-Western emerging and frontier markets, including ongoing operations in Russia (Multon Partners / Dobry Cola) subject to sanctions and expropriation risk, and high exposure to volatile developing markets (Nigeria, Egypt) lacking rule of law and stable property rights.
qualitative.evidence: Coca-Cola Hellenic Bottling Company operates across 29 countries where the Emerging segment accounts for ~45-47% of net sales revenue. Key profit contributors include Russia (retained local bottling and juice operations post-2022) and Nigeria, where severe currency devaluations, capital controls, and geopolitical instability introduce severe sovereign and rule-of-law risks.
